meta.source: https://www.authkit.com/ — local pixel-fidelity clone at /Users/riyaghosh/V3/authkit (React 18 + Vite + Tailwind v3). Structure derived from the clone's own source (src/App.jsx SECTIONS array + the nine section components), cross-checked against CLONE_SPEC.md §2.
meta.notes: Single-route site. Verified against the live original: no sitemap.xml, no robots.txt, every href is off-domain, and 15 probed candidate routes (/docs /pricing /blog /about /login /signup /features /security /changelog /legal /privacy /terms /contact /customers /enterprise) all return 404. Only / returns 200. The IA's value here is the section-and-component inventory, not route coverage.

categories.CHROME: Structural furniture that frames content rather than being content: the static header, the inter-section rule, the hero's hairline grid tracks.
categories.HERO: Above-the-fold identity and product-preview blocks living inside the hero's 17x14 hairline grid.
categories.CAPABILITY: Compact enumeration of product capabilities as icon+label tiles.
categories.PRODUCT_DEMO: Full-width animated demonstrations of a product behaviour, each driven by an IntersectionObserver sequence.
categories.PROOF: Third-party credibility blocks — customer quotes and logos.

chrome.hero-header.description: Static top bar inside the hero grid: WorkOS mark, 'powered by' wordmark and a GitHub link. Deliberately position:static with no scroll behaviour, no blur and no sticky state.
chrome.hero-header.scope: The single homepage template. There is no <nav> element on this site.

chrome.page-separator.description: 1px --blue-6 horizontal rule placed between sections. Rendered before radix, security, complete and testimonials only — four of the nine section boundaries carry it.
chrome.page-separator.scope: Emitted by the App shell at 4 of 8 inter-section boundaries on the homepage template.
chrome.page-separator.implementedBy: primitives.jsx > PageSeparator (driven by separatorBefore in App.jsx SECTIONS)

chrome.hairline-grid.description: The hero's visible 1px grid tracks: six vertical lines, horizontal lines, wide lines and two cross marks. Reproduces the original's track bug verbatim — the stylesheet declares areas vs-line-1/2 while the DOM uses v-line-5/6, so two lines auto-place.
chrome.hairline-grid.scope: Hero only, on the homepage template.

hero.wordmark.description: The AuthKit logotype in a 512x135 outlined box, 476x106 SVG inside.

hero.headline.description: 'Introducing' eyebrow plus the 512x87 headline block in an outlined box.

hero.auth-card-trio.description: Three staggered sign-in card previews (344x386, 392x459, 344x386) at x=100/444/836, each wrapped in a JS-driven tilt hook. Rendered from one shared card component, not three copies.
hero.auth-card-trio.scope: Hero only — but the same component also renders the customiser preview, giving 4 instances site-wide.

hero.light-switch.description: Role=switch light/dark toggle. Flips data-state and adds .light to the card subtree, swapping card/button/input appearances via the class cascade rather than forked components. Thumb travels translateX(116px) over 0.6s cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1); enters on a 2.1s delay.
hero.light-switch.scope: Hero only. The one piece of real stateful UI outside the customiser.

hero.ambient-fx.description: Non-interactive atmosphere: three spotlights with per-instance --rotate/--scale/--duration, a one-shot 2.669s flare video (740x300, no loop), and a 1280x1222 particle canvas at opacity .5.
hero.ambient-fx.scope: Hero only. The sole prefers-reduced-motion carve-out in the original covers the spotlights.

capability.feature-strip.description: Six 48x48 icon+label tiles (SSO, Password, Multi-Factor Auth, Social Login, RBAC, Magic Auth) in a 788x80 strip. One-shot entrance with a 1.2s stagger step via --delay:calc(var(--i)*1.2s), gated by --play-state until first intersection. Not a carousel.
capability.feature-strip.scope: Its own section on the homepage template, directly below the hero.

demo.dashboard.description: 1032px-tall node diagram in a 1440 wrapper: application, auth, work, user, events and database nodes joined by five masked connector lines. Nine database bars at 2px resting; per-dot typewriter delays of 0.2s + 0.1s x index.
demo.dashboard.scope: One of five product-demo sections on the homepage template.

demo.custom-ui-browser.description: 1040x1248 section with a 992px faux-browser chrome containing a live auth-card preview, plus its own canvas and five decorative opacity:.75 PNG cards.
demo.custom-ui-browser.scope: Homepage template. Hosts the customiser pickers.

demo.customiser-pickers.description: Twelve interactive buttons in three pickers driving the card preview: 4 colour swatches to --brand-color (#663AF3 default), 4 radii (0/3px/6/9999px) to --brand-radius, and a 4-up logo picker to --i, which offsets a single SVG sprite via object-position:calc(32px * var(--i) * -1).
demo.customiser-pickers.scope: Inside the custom-UI section only. The second of two genuinely stateful widgets on the site.

demo.radix.description: 1177x399 component-kit image above a 560x833 layered logo reveal (stroke, main, blender, three masked line items). Carries desktop and mobile heading variants — the only section that does.

demo.security-cards.description: 1044x492 grid of four 320x242 animated cards — leaked-password radar, password-strength bars, automatic-detection radar, and the multi/RBAC box with its dot-matrix readout. Each has its own observer-driven -active sequence.

demo.complete-diagram.description: Composite diagram with masked halo, multi and single line overlays, a directory block, social row, and a six-dot user progress column.

proof.testimonials.description: Two 498x384 quote cells in a 996px bordered row, each with a company mark, quote body and a 40x40 circular avatar with name and role.
proof.testimonials.scope: Homepage template. The only third-party-content section.

conversion.cta-header.description: Closing gradient h2 with description, using the shared section-header type scale.
conversion.cta-header.scope: CTA section on the homepage template.

conversion.cta-boxes.description: Two 442x332 dotted outline boxes (hosted AuthKit and the GitHub/X links) above a 450x100 action row of glowing buttons. All destination hrefs are deliberately inert.
conversion.cta-boxes.scope: CTA section on the homepage template.
conversion.cta-boxes.implementedBy: Cta.jsx (.cta-boxes, .cta-actions) + primitives.jsx > OutlineBox, GlowingButton + icons.jsx > XGlyph
